changes.title: Changes
changes.intro: Deployments and other changes in your teams and services.
changes.limited: You can view the link to your service. Full details and event history are available to the owner team.
changes.conflict: Conflicting final outcomes. A later final event is required to resolve the conflict.
changes.load_error: Could not load changes. Use Reload to retry.
changes.filter_error: Could not load filter options. Use Reload to retry.
changes.unavailable: This change is unavailable or you no longer have access.
changes.mapping_current: Service mapping is up to date
changes.dead: Processing failed; an administrator can retry it
pages.changes.title: Changes
pages.changes.subtitle: Deployments and other changes in your teams and services.
changes.select_target: Select an alert episode or Incident
changes.target_permission_hint: A responder role is required. Only existing alert episodes are available.
changes.review_hint: This records your assessment. It does not change alert or Incident status or send notifications.
changes.review_conflict: The server reported a conflict without a recognized reason. Close this dialog, click {reload} and check the current relation before trying again.
changes.save_error: Could not save the relation. Check your input or retry.
changes.episode_picker_hint: Search existing alert episodes by title. More results load as you scroll. Responder permission is required.
changes.incident_picker_hint: Search incidents by title. More results load as you scroll. Responder permission is required.
changes.review_conflict_relation_exists: This alert episode already has a relation to this Change. Close this dialog, click {reload}, then use {manual} on the existing entry in {episodes}.
changes.review_conflict_relation_changed: This relation has already been reviewed or changed. Close this dialog, click {reload} and check the current decision before reviewing it again.
changes.review_conflict_suggestion_stale: This automatic suggestion is no longer current. Close this dialog, wait for recalculation and click {reload}. To record your own assessment independently, use {manual}.
changes.review_conflict_evidence_changed: The automatic correlation data has been recalculated. Close this dialog, click {reload} and review the updated evidence before confirming or rejecting the suggestion.
changes.review_conflict_incident_role_co: This Change is already linked to the selected Incident with a different role. Close this dialog, click {reload}, then use {edit} on the existing entry in {incidents}.
changes.review_conflict_incident_link_re: This Incident link has been removed. Close this dialog, click {reload}, then use {restore} in {incidents} if the link is still needed.
changes.review_conflict_incident_link_ch: This Incident link has changed since the page was loaded. Close this dialog, click {reload} and check its current role and status before trying again.
changes.review_conflict_incident_link_mi: The Incident link you tried to restore no longer exists. Close this dialog, click {reload}, then use {link} to create it again if needed.
changes.review_conflict_incident_changed: The Incident was updated by another request. Close this dialog, click {reload} and check the Incident's current state before repeating the link action.
changes.related_alert_help: Suggestions and decisions for the selected alert episode.
changes.related_incident_help: Changes linked to this investigation and their roles.
changes.change_picker_hint: Search accessible changes by title. Limited entries can be found by kind.
changes.eligibility_no_episode: This group has no tracked episode. History is not reconstructed.
changes.eligibility_unknown_start: Automatic suggestions are unavailable: the episode start is unknown.
changes.eligibility_unknown_context: Automatic suggestions are unavailable: the episode context is unknown.
changes.eligibility_no_service: Automatic suggestions are unavailable: no service is linked.
changes.eligibility_service_unavailable: Automatic suggestions are unavailable: the service is disabled or unavailable.
changes.eligibility_service_replaced: Automatic suggestions are unavailable: the original service was replaced.
changes.eligibility_service_moved: Automatic suggestions are unavailable: the service moved to another team.
changes.eligibility_disabled: Automatic suggestions are disabled for this service. Manual links remain available.
changes.eligibility_outside_history: This episode is outside the automatic search window. Manual links remain available.
changes.eligibility_all_excluded: All alerts in this episode are excluded from automatic correlation.
changes.eligibility_no_children: This episode has no alert context for automatic correlation.
changes.eligibility_eligible: This episode participates in automatic correlation. Suggestions are not proof of a cause.
